mo_ta_cong_viec:
Join MiTek's Global Cloud Operations Team
MiTek is looking for Senior DevOps Engineers (Cloud Azure) to support, optimize and expand our global Azure cloud infrastructure and Azure DevOps ecosystem.
This role is ideal for cloud professionals who are passionate about automation, infrastructure as code, cloud operations, DevOps best practices and enterprise-scale environments. Senior-level candidates will have opportunities to mentor junior engineers and lead cloud initiatives across the organization.
 
What You Will Do
Serve as a cloud supporting point for the Cloud Engineer I and II team members. 
Support Managed Services offered in Azure 
Apply Azure subscription/tagging standards; uphold least privilege and access reviews 
Assist in supporting our external customer AVD environment 
Design and support Azure DevOps pipelines 
Assist in managing our Azure DevOps environment 
Implement and audit Azure DevOps security controls (secure variables, audit logs, service connections, environments) 
Assist the Cloud Architecture team with the implementation of cloud-based solutions 
Implement our TTO (Transition to Operations) process for new services 
Enforce change control with ServiceNow and ADO release gates/approvals. 
Meet patch SLAs and security baselines 
Validate backup policies and perform restore tests; maintain DR playbooks. 
Mentor Cloud Engineer I/II and create Work Instructions for common tasks 
Hours: Would like person to have a 2-3-hour overlap with US timezone.
yeu_cau:
5 - 7+ years of relevant IT, Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, or Systems Engineering experience 
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services; experience with AWS or GCP is also valuable 
Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, scripting, or Automation tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, JSON, YAML, or similar technologies. 
Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, or similar DevOps platforms 
Experience writing or maintaining YAML pipelines, CI/CD workflows, deployment templates 
Experience supporting Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows Server, Azure storage 
Some familiarity with ServiceNow 
Proficient in English 
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) Certification is preferred 
Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) Certification is preferred 
Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred. Technology Stack: Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), PowerShell, Azure CLI, GitHub Enterprise, YAML, CI/CD, ServiceNow.
